ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens on a white square plate: curly, ruffled leaves in bright green with some reddish-purple/burgundy edged leaves and darker maroon patches, dry-looking with slight wilting, leaf pieces about 4-8 cm long, piled in a loose mound covering roughly one-third of the plate, no dressing or sheen visible | 60

ITEM 2 | Small scattered specks of a brownish-tan granular material (possibly seeds or crumbs) lying on the plate near the lower edge of the greens, dry, matte, each speck about 0.3-0.5 cm across, a few pieces in total | 1
